summary: Verified Calendar#first_free_slot by running the test suite, RuboCop, and the spec's seven console checks plus edge cases: all seven checks pass, the suite is 10 runs / 0 failures, RuboCop is clean.

blocks.caption: Acceptance check 1: runbook test command reports 10 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors (5 prior + 5 added)
Acceptance check 2: RuboCop reports no offenses on calendar.rb and test_calendar.rb (whole repo also clean)
Acceptance check 4: the 30-minute 09:00-09:30 gap is skipped; result is 10:00-11:00
Acceptance check 5: a gap of exactly 60 minutes qualifies; result is 10:00-11:00
Acceptance check 6: out-of-window bookings at 07:00 and 18:00 do not leak past 09:00-17:00
Acceptance check 7: with no qualifying gap it raises Calendar::NoFreeSlot with the specified message, not nil
All seven console checks in one run, as observed
Edge cases: fully booked day raises; only a 30-minute gap raises; gaps() still returns 08:00-17:00 for a 07:00 booking while first_free_slot clamps to 09:00-17:00
